en.topic_title: Hong Kong Int’l School and US church founder reach settlement over financial mismanagement lawsuit
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong International School (HKIS) and its US-based founder have reached an out-of-court settlement, after the latter sued the school last year for alleged financial mismanagement and over accusations it served only an “elite” section of the city’s population.



Hong Kong International School’s Lower Primary campus in Repulse Bay. Photo: HKIS.
